scope: Exact local-minimum, maximum, degeneracy and metastability classification for K1271's conditional quartic fiber.

morse_classification.subcritical: the two outer critical points are strict local minima and the middle point is a strict local maximum
morse_classification.subcritical_global_minimum: the outer minimum with sign opposite epsilon is the unique global minimum
morse_classification.subcritical_metastable_minimum: the outer minimum with sign equal to epsilon remains a strict local minimum
morse_classification.threshold_degenerate_point: F''=0 and F''' is nonzero, hence a stationary inflection rather than a local extremum
morse_classification.supercritical: the unique critical point has sign opposite epsilon and is a strict global minimum

decision.metastable_opposite_sign_elimination_thr: |epsilon| greater than or equal to epsilon_c

claim_ceiling: Exact finite Morse and bifurcation classification. Unique global selection, removal of the metastable basin and an everywhere-Morse one-critical-point landscape are distinct requirements.
